description: The Atlas's open questions (evidence gaps with testable hypotheses) and frontier questions. Paged. By default still_open is shortened at a sentence boundary (still_open_truncated); get_question has the full text, or pass brief=false.

brief.description: Shorten still_open; false returns the full text.

limit.description: Maximum 50; a larger value is capped at 50.

offset.description: For the next page: pass next_offset from the previous answer.

query.description: Keywords to find questions by their title, gap, hypothesis or what is still open, e.g. "rapamycin immune".

name: list_questions
title: List open questions
